items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Stack(?) Walton played tenor and Lorenzo Lawson played the other tenor. ... Lorenzo Lawson was the tenor player. ... Lorenzo Lawson playing the other tenor, and I was playing alto in the middle.

ctx.x: So I first came to rehearsal that day, and we were playing in a shell... That's the first time I had really played in a shell where it really killed the sound. Boy, I could barely hear myself. So some of the guys were looking around at me funny...! [LAUGHS]

So after the first night, after I'd played with them, we rehearsed the show and everything. I was playing... Well, they only had one alto at the time, so I was playing the lead. They had two tenors. Stack(?) Walton played tenor and Lorenzo Lawson played the other tenor. And... I can give the full personnel of that band in a few minutes.

Anyway, so after the first night, at the end of the night, he took me back in the dressing room, he came and talked to me and he says, "Look, everything is going to be all right, but we've got to work on your power." And this was my first time hearing anything about diaphragm breathing on the saxophone. And he showed me how to do it. And I'll forever be grateful to him, because the air is still the most important thing when you're playing a wind instrument - - is how you use the air. And he showed me how to use…
